scope: Actual Three.js visualizer using the same archived v084 GLBs and each family's own original photo

foundation.observed: The raised leg visibly passes through the petticoats; the skirts retain rigid hip motion. The full original sheet remains visible beside the actual animated mesh.

whole.observed: A broad stretched surface joins the hand/glove region to the side of the skirt, and the raised thigh enters the skirt. The whole model's original three-view sheet remains visible.

limitations: This records direct visual inspection of selected motion and camera controls. It does not approve every frame, game transitions, cloth physics, body contact, or final character fidelity.
